facts.fact: NCDC, the Healthcare Federation of Nigeria and PharmAccess signed a memorandum framing a pilot of automated private-sector IDSR reporting into NCDC's SORMAS surveillance system, to test interoperable approaches; no facilities or start date are given.
facts.system: Private-sector IDSR reporting pilot into SORMAS

systems.system: SORMAS (Surveillance Outbreak Response Management and Analysis System)

note: as_of is the document's published date; the signing date is not stated.
